rivals.R1: The nine lawful raw re-entry edges expose a local contextual overlap that bridges the target components.
rivals.R2: Any comparable amount of additional contextual overlap on the old frontier would work; re-entry is not causal.
rivals.R3: Neither matched old-frontier overlap nor re-entry-conditioned overlap bridges the residual; a different composition mechanism is missing.

arms.A: Frozen target-narrowing graph plus a matched number of old-frontier-only overlap applications.
arms.B: Same frozen graph plus exactly the nine raw cap-19 z:=target_rhs re-entry substitutions, then overlaps only between new re-entry nodes and old frontier nodes.

decision_rule.R1_REENTRY_OVERLAP_CAUSAL: Arm B obtains a component join or replayable closure and matched Arm A does not.
decision_rule.R2_GENERIC_OVERLAP_SUFFICIENT: Arm A obtains a component join or replayable closure.
decision_rule.R3_OVERLAP_INSUFFICIENT: Neither arm obtains a component join or replayable closure.
decision_rule.MEASUREMENT_FAILURE: The historical reproduction, operative cap, or nine-edge re-entry facts fail to reproduce.
